findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_agent, chat_with_agent, about_agent · Private data: leave_contact · Public sink: send_agent_message, leave_contact · Destructive: ask_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_agent, chat_with_agent, about_agent · Private data: leave_contact · Public sink: send_agent_message, leave_contact · Destructive: ask_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
